desc: Derive and verify the reverse-processing observation that transforms dynamic insertions into selecting empty final positions.
Implement a Fenwick tree supporting point updates and prefix-sum queries over the N positions.
Implement Fenwick binary lifting to locate the position of the k-th empty slot.
Process values from N down to 1, assign each value to its selected slot, and mark that slot occupied.
Build stdin/stdout handling, verify samples, and output the resulting array space-separated.
